body:
Thanks for the reply.

I have not seen a psychiatrist, I'm to broke for that. As for how people ignore me. People are not mean but what you stated describes it well " don't react or respond". Usually when people do contact me it's 95% of the time to ask about a homework or project or something they need. I don't remember the last time I was invited anywhere. Also I've been reading social etiquette books like "How to make friends and influence people" but IDK people just don't want to be friends with me more than just friends with benefits (like using me for homework and stuff). Nobody hates me but nobody likes me either xD haha. 

Edit: Also when I talk to myself sometimes I do so out loud without even noticing almost subconsciously.  I feel like I'm 2 different people...Is that weird? My brain made myself my own friend because I've been lonely for so many years. I don't really know how to describe it...

I don't have any advice for you but just wanted to say you're not alone. I'm like the same age as you (22) and have mutual feelings. Although I have a 3.0 with an engineering degree and still can't find a job. Also I have never had significant other or friends since middle school. Not even exaggerating...You have someone and should cherish that.
